description: My husband works in SoHo and lives in Summit, New Jersey. Sometimes his journey home takes more than three hours, and I find myself wondering what happened along the way. I made this map to understand his route home and the connections it depends on, hoping for a more reliable and comfortable public transit journey.

The animation compares his usual commute with alternatives during the Portal North Bridge cutover. I used published transit schedules and service advisories to check route patterns and transfer points, then drew each option as a schematic over a geographic basemap with Census TIGER/Line water polygons and USGS 3DEP elevation data. The maps show how the connections change during the reroute. Historical door-to-door travel times were not verified.
alt: Animated schematic map of the commute from SoHo to Summit, New Jersey, showing the usual route and alternatives during a rail reroute.
basemap_wording_correction: OpenStreetMap → geographic basemap with Census TIGER/Line water polygons; USGS 3DEP retained.
